Configuration

Configuration model

There is no runtime environment-variable configuration in this repository. Customization happens by editing source files and rebuilding. Do not add credentials to page variables or assume a build-time value will remain private in generated HTML.

Page content and metadata

Edit src/pug/index.pug to change landing-page headings, navigation, imagery, page title, and description. Its background images and portrait currently reference remote providers; replace those URLs or add local images deliberately.

Documentation pages live in src/pug/docs/ . Each extends ../layouts/docs and sets pageTitle , currentPage , and description in its variables block. The common navigation and page structure live in src/pug/layouts/docs.pug .

When adding a guide, add its filename and label to the layout's pages list. Use the filename without .pug as currentPage so the active navigation item is correct. Restart the development watcher after adding pages.

Styles and assets

Edit src/scss/styles.scss to customize styles. It imports Bootstrap and defines the template's .bg-image-full background helper. Keep documentation-specific overrides scoped so they do not unexpectedly change the landing page.

Place images and icons under src/assets/ ; the build copies that folder to dist/assets/ . A documentation page can reference a local file as ../assets/example.png , while the landing page uses assets/example.png . Create the actual asset before adding the reference.

Custom browser behavior belongs under src/js/ . Documentation navigation works without JavaScript; no extra script is required for these pages.

Build and preview settings

package.json defines the npm commands and template metadata used in generated banners. Build implementations are in scripts/build-*.js and scripts/render-*.js . scripts/start.js launches BrowserSync against dist/ alongside scripts/sb-watch.js . Changes to these scripts require restarting the preview.

There is no separate documentation build or base-path setting. Use relative links such as getting-started.html between documentation pages and ../index.html to return to the template. Keep generated directories together when mounting the output below a subdirectory.

Verify a customization

npm run build
npm run test:docs

Then preview the affected pages at both narrow and wide widths. Automated link checks do not replace reviewing content, appearance, or keyboard navigation.
